move.subject: Seal 340010 – binding multi-year commitment at contract lead time
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. You said you prioritise firm, long-term commitments, and we can offer one. We propose a binding 23,400 pcs/year at the contract lead time of 42 days (ctr:4600070410#5.1), with a choice of term:

A) 36 months at EUR 29.89/unit
B) 24 months at EUR 30.25/unit

EUR 29.89 is the price on our September orders (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). The framework also fixes prices per calendar year (ctr:4600070410#3.1).

A fixed annual volume committed up front should let you plan capacity for 42 days rather than rely on overtime. Our September forecast of 21,310 (fc:340010@2026-09) is a planning figure. The 23,400/year in these packages would be binding.

Which package can your planning support at 42 days? If neither, please tell us whether term length or price is the harder constraint for you, so we can adjust the right lever.

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.subject: Two packages for 23,400 pcs/year: lead time vs. term
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the clear answer. We take your point on lead time, so here are two packages, each for a binding 23,400 pcs/year:

A) 56 days, 24 months, EUR 30.30/unit
B) 42 days, 36 months, EUR 31.10/unit

Package A follows your advice on lead time. Its 56 days is longer than the 54 days in your opening quotation, so it needs no extraordinary planning. It also doubles that quotation's term and raises its annual volume.

Package B responds to your note that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments (doc:20260918-70410-P10). It offers three fixed years on a level monthly schedule, which you can plan into regular shifts rather than overtime.

We ordered 19,880 units in the last twelve months (p10:ordered_last_12m_units), so 23,400 is a larger binding volume, not a repeat of past call-offs. Our bottom-up estimate of your plant cost is EUR 24.31 before margin (cost:340010). That is a low-confidence buyer estimate, not a claim about your accounts.

Which package fits your capacity plan better?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your cost estimate has been noted, though it does not fully account for our specialized manufacturing requirements. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We acknowledge your willingness to extend the lead time to 56 days, which accommodates our standard production scheduling. Based on this extended lead time, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit for the 24-month term. 

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
